genera.Amanita: This genus includes the death cap and destroying angels, which cause fatal liver failure.
genera.Galerina: Contains amatoxins, the same deadly toxins as the death cap.
genera.Lepiota: Several small Lepiota species contain deadly amatoxins.
genera.Conocybe: Some species, such as Conocybe filaris, contain deadly amatoxins.
genera.Cortinarius: Some species cause kidney failure that can appear days after eating.
genera.Gyromitra: False morels contain gyromitrin, which can be fatal.
genera.Clitocybe: Some white Clitocybe species contain dangerous levels of muscarine.
genera.Inocybe: Many species contain dangerous levels of muscarine.
genera.Omphalotus: Jack-o'-lantern mushrooms cause severe poisoning and resemble chanterelles.
genera.Paxillus: Brown roll-rim can trigger a potentially fatal immune reaction.
genera.Conium: Poison hemlock is deadly. It resembles wild carrot, parsley and fennel.
genera.Cicuta: Water hemlock is one of the most toxic plants in North America and Europe.
genera.Oenanthe: Hemlock water-dropwort is deadly and looks like wild carrot, parsnip and celery.
genera.Aconitum: Monkshood is highly toxic, even through the skin.
genera.Atropa: Deadly nightshade berries and leaves can be fatal.
genera.Digitalis: Foxglove contains heart toxins and can be fatal.
genera.Taxus: Almost every part of the yew is highly toxic.
genera.Nerium: Oleander contains heart toxins and can be fatal.
genera.Datura: Datura (jimsonweed) causes severe, potentially fatal poisoning.
genera.Veratrum: False hellebore is highly toxic and resembles wild garlic and gentian.
genera.Toxicodendron: Poison ivy, oak and sumac cause severe skin reactions on contact.
genera.Heracleum: Giant hogweed sap causes severe burns in sunlight.
genera.Inosperma: Many species (formerly Inocybe) contain dangerous levels of muscarine.
genera.Aethusa: Fool's parsley is poisonous and looks like parsley and coriander.
genera.Convallaria: Lily of the valley contains heart toxins. Its leaves look like wild garlic.
genera.Colchicum: Autumn crocus is deadly. Its leaves look like wild garlic.
genera.Arum: Lords-and-ladies is toxic. Its young leaves grow among wild garlic.
